name: Windshear Crag
summary: In central Stonetalon, Windshear Crag lies stripped by the Venture Company's logging. Machinery and muddy runoff have replaced the old forest. Kobolds dig for ore nearby, and a mountain path leads beneath the ridges to Ashenvale.

sections.title: Industrial Devastation
sections.body: The Venture Company cut down Windshear Crag's old forest for profit. Stumps and machinery now fill the basin. From a platform above Cragpool Lake, Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle oversees the logging. The leper gnome's engineering gave the company the Super Reaper 6000, a machine that fells great trees in moments. As the operation strips the mountain bare, rival engineers and local inhabitants grow angry.

sections.title: Mines and Mountain Passes
sections.body: Logging is not the only danger or crossing at Windshear Crag. In the southeast, kobolds dig through Windshear Mine for Smoky Iron Ingots. They attack those who come near their haul. From the crag's northeast reaches, the Talondeep Path runs beneath the ridges into Ashenvale. Near its entrance, the tauren elder Braug Dimspirit tests the historical wisdom and resolve of Horde travelers crossing the contested peaks.

faq.q: Who is running the logging operation here?
aliases: who is the boss of windshear
faq.answer: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle directs the logging at Windshear Crag. The leper gnome engineer works under contract with the Venture Company. He watches over the crag from a timber platform above Cragpool Lake.

Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle built the Super Reaper 6000 as a mechanical logging prototype. It clears timber at great speed, grinding ancient mountain trees into sawdust within moments and hastening the company's clear-cutting.

faq.q: Why is the Undermine Tinkers' Union targeting Gerenzo?
faq.answer: Director Riddlevox of Undermine's Tinkers' Union wants Gerenzo dead. Ziz Fizziks, a goblin who helped steal the Super Reaper 6000 blueprints, carries out the order. Undermine's trade princes disapprove of the Venture Company consorting with the gnome.

faq.q: Where does the cave in the northeast lead?
faq.answer: The cave in the northeast is the Talondeep Path. It runs beneath the mountain roots and connects Windshear Crag to Ashenvale by foot.

faq.q: Who are the kobolds digging in the southeast?
faq.answer: Windshear kobolds have overrun the mine in the crag's southeast. They defend their claim as they dig for Smoky Iron Ingots, which regional smiths use.

angles.text: The machinery across Windshear Crag reveals goblin trade secrets and Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle's lethal Super Reaper designs.
On the way to Ashenvale, Horde travelers meet Braug Dimspirit near the Talondeep Path. He tests their knowledge of Kalimdor's history.
